changelog: Remote YouTube Video & Jumpscare Overlay with Master Volume Control: Admin can remotely play any YouTube URL or 1-click jumpscare preset (Ghost Screamer, FNAF, Rickroll, Siren, Evil Laugh) on any target PC or fleet-wide. Takes over screen fullscreen above DirectX games, dynamically adjusts Windows Master Volume up to 100%, and automatically restores the user's previous volume upon video completion or dismissal.
